name: read_new_sources
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
for n in ['sevencycle','highgirth','vertexcritical']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources'/str(n+'.pdf')),'-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/'+n+'.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
 print('\nSOURCE',n,'chars',len(r.stdout),'\n',r.stdout[:13500])
